text: Ndipo anamuyankha kuti, “Ku Betelehemu wa ku Yudeya chifukwa izi ndi zimene mneneri analemba kuti,
Inu mumaopa lupanga, koma lupangalo ndi limene ndidzakubweretsereni, akutero Ambuye.
Iwo anachoka ndi kukatumikira milungu ina ndi kuyipembedza, milungu imene sanayidziwe, milungu imene sanawapatse.
Anasiya Nkhani zaku Canterbury osamalizidwa, atangomaliza nkhani 24 pa 100 zoyambirira zomwe zidakonzedwa koyambirira.
Nyanja Yamchere imagwirizanitsidwa ndi Nyanja Atlantic ndi Khwalala ya Gibraltar komanso ndi Nyanja Yofiira ndi Ngalande ya Suez yopangidwa ndi anthu.
Iye wakhala ndi zolemba khumi ndi zinayi zowerengeka pa chati ya Billboard Hot 100.
Abale awo a ku midzi yawo amabwera nthawi ndi nthawi kudzagwira ntchito yawo kwa masiku asanu ndi awiri.
Nditayangʼana ndinangoona dzanja litaloza ine, litagwira mpukutu wolembedwa.
Analowa nati kwa iwo, “Mukuchita phokoso ndi kulira chifukwa chiyani? Mwanayu sanamwalire koma ali mtulo.”
Nyimbo zake ndizokoma kwabasi.Tiyeni tonse timulondole pa webusaiti yake ya youtube.
Chifukwa chake, pali anthu 18 kapena kupitilira apo omwe akugawidwa mu anthropology ya Madagascar, omwe ambiri ndi Merina a ku mapiri apakati.
